product_metadata.title: FURIOUS Computer Gaming Chair,Home Office Desk Chair with Lumbar Support,Fabric Swivel Office Chair,Video Gamer Chair for Teens and Kids,Blue
features: EXCELLENT COMFORT：Furious racing desk chair using high density sponge seat cushion and soft foam backrest covered with breathable mesh fabric which has good elasticity.Wider and Larger size seat,suitable for people of all ages.Easy adjustment of the seat height and 20 degree seat angle,Provide extra Comfort for Gaming, Working, Studying and Resting.

ERGONOMIC DESIGN：With Curved backrest,Featuring reliable ergonomic lumbar support, Perfectly support your spine's natural curve,Like a pair of hands, pushing up and holding your low back, Ease pressure & pain on back for Everyday use.

STURDY AND RELIABLE：Durable 5 star metal base for superior stability .Solid rolling casters and 120ML gas cylinder which has SGS- Certified. 360 degree swivel wheels, Tested by 1000 miles rolling. This Furious computer chair has passed the BIFMA X5.1 TEST. It’s Reliable and Sturdy option for customers Under 250 LBS.
EASY TO INSTALL：The Furious chair comes easy to install with all the tools necessary, you’ll be set up and ready to game, take on the office in about 15-20 minutes!
WARRANTY and GUARANTEE：FURIOUS provide 12 months manufacture warranty.Any questions feel free to contact FURIOUS customer service.
